node.title: Compute Q_H(eta) exactly for 2-power domains at the four rates
node.notes: pure divisor-count computation; conj:B's profile hypothesis is unverifiable on official rows without it | IN FLIGHT: #195 (#205 closed as redundant) | pma_pullback_lists REALIZES the quotient-profile mass concretely — the profile budget this node computes is exactly what charges the counterexample family. | FLIP on replay (consolidation agent): exact big-int reproduction of QA.22 (log2 Q_M* = 99.81/66.15/82.97); first-scale dominance proved; n-uniform (RowC = prize); rate-1/2 parity-killed. | #156 SCOPE (2026-07-13): the 'rate-1/2 carries no dyadic quotient mass / parity-killed' claim is scoped to the ODD-A M > t_res rows; the qa22 extension's even-A rate-1/2 own rows are nonzero (and carry the grid's largest first-scale column + the exact COL cap 4).
node.statement:
[lifted verbatim 2026-07-27 from this node's own proof.md Statement section] Compute the quotient profile `Q_H(eta)` exactly for **2-power (dyadic) domains**
`n = 2^m` at the four rates `rho in {1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16}`. Here the quotient
mass on a dyadic scale `M = 2^i | n` (with `M > t`, `t = A - k`) is the fixed-tail
quotient-coset count (banked `thm:qcore` / `prop:qfloor`, and the QA.22 column
convention)

```
Q_M = C(n/M - 1, floor(A/M)),          M | n,  M > t,                      (Q)
```

and the profile is `Q_H = sum_{M|n, M>t} Q_M` (with the dihedral/Chebyshev
companion `D_M`, below). "`eta`" is the reserve `eta = t/n`, which sets the
smallest admissible `M`. The deliverable is the *exact* value of `(Q)` at each
rate for both a small dyadic row (RowC, `n = 2^10`) and the prize dyadic row
(`n = 2^41`), together with the structural facts that make the profile
well-defined and computable: **first-scale dominance** and **n-uniformity**.
